agyos_skill.intent: Lightweight Gmail integration with standalone OAuth authentication. No MCP server required.
agyos_skill.instructions: Lightweight Gmail integration with standalone OAuth authentication. No MCP server required. > **⚠️ Requires Google Workspace account.** Personal Gmail accounts are not supported. - You need to search, read, or send Gmail messages from the command line without an MCP server. - You are automating inbox workflows for a Google Workspace account. - You want a lightweight Gmail integration backed by standalone OAuth scripts. Authenticate with Google (opens browser): ```bash python scripts/auth.py login ``` Check authentication status: ```bash python scripts/auth.py status ``` Logout when needed: ```bash python scripts/auth.py logout ``` All operations via `scripts/gmail.py`. Auto-authenticates on first use if not logged in. ```bash python scripts/gmail.py search "from:someone@example.com is:unread" python scripts/gmail.py search --limit 20 python scripts/gmail.py search --label INBOX --limit 10 python scripts/gmail.py search "subject:important" --include-spam-trash ``` ```bash
